image_prompt.text: The large central grassy platform, sized and raised to read as the anchor of the map from every outer platform
Chains of floating rocks and trailing vines linking the outer platforms back to the central one, giving the archipelago an obvious grain
Composed outward views from the platform edges, looking across the floating grassy islands and the open air between them
6-8 smaller grassy platforms floating at varying heights and distances around the central one, open air between them, each grass-topped over exposed dirt and earth
The large central grassy platform players start on, composed so the surrounding floating islands are the first thing in view
3-4 small trees with green leafy canopies standing on some of the platforms
Scattered rocks and boulders with small bushes dressing the platform surfaces
An organic, natural, outdoorsy look throughout, in greens, browns and earthy tones

layout_placement.text: Player start point on the large central grassy platform

notes: Classified None: the prompt says 'RNG' but describes no game loop at all - no rolling, rarity, upgrades, scoring or objective - only a nature-themed floating-platform place with tweakable parameters, so no genre was invented for it.

would have asked: RNG games usually mean rolling for rare drops from a fixed spot. Is there a rolling or upgrade loop happening on these platforms, or is this purely the map? (If there is a loop, this becomes Simulation.)

would have asked: Sounds like an explorable place - a large central grassy platform to start on, 6-8 smaller ones floating around it at different heights, rock-and-vine links between them, and a couple of composed viewpoints out over the islands. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?

would have asked: confirming rather than asking - the platforms sit at varying heights, so this is built as tiered ground rather than one flat surface, and nothing sits directly above anything else so it stays a single-pass build.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space? Nobody was present to answer, so nothing was added on the user's behalf.
Preset Explorable Place taken whole, plus spawn-area for the stated starting platform, and the verticality axis raised from its default single-surface to tiered for the varying platform heights.

CHECK comes from island-cluster and is probably benign here: the platforms are dispersed radially at varying heights rather than layered one directly above another, so the play volume should not self-occlude.
Counts were stated as ranges (6-8 platforms, 3-4 trees) and are carried in the option text; count holds a single stated number and normalising a range would misreport it.
Scale: the user asked for a medium-sized map fitting roughly within a 150x150 stud area.
Outside the layout handoff: the user asked for tweakable attributes exposed for platform count, platform size, grass colour, platform height variation, tree count and rock count.
